title: Real LoRa drivers lack one-shot recv_async contract (lr1110/sim/renode -ENOTSUP, 3-arg stubs vs v3.7.0 2-arg pin)
description: Found by 3x codereview of project-LICHEN-worker6-sb0b (correctness/security/robustness). The async L2 RX (sb0b) requires a one-shot recv_async: driver delivers one packet, disarms, L2 re-arms after processing. Current state: (1) lichen/drivers/lora/lr1110/lr1110.c:627, lora_sim.c:433, lora_renode.c:279 are -ENOTSUP stubs AND use the 3-arg (dev,cb,user_data) signature, which is incompatible with the pinned Zephyr v3.7.0 2-arg lora_recv_async(dev,cb) - any config building those drivers cannot compile under the pin, while 4.1.0-workspace builds break the new 2-arg L2 call sites instead. (2) With fail-closed start() (sb0b), lichen_lora_l2_start() on T1000-E (LR1110, primary bench target) always reverts to STOPPED until the driver implements recv_async. Fix: implement 2-arg one-shot recv_async in lr1110/lora_sim/lora_renode (DIO1 RX_DONE IRQ -> cb -> disarm; NULL cb cancels), or gate those boards explicitly at build time. Loopback driver in sb0b is the reference implementation.
close_reason: Ported every LICHEN LoRa driver + L2 + in-tree test consumer to the Zephyr 4.1.0 one-shot async API: lora_recv_async(dev, cb, user_data) with lora_recv_cb gaining the trailing void *user_data. Files: lora_sim.c, lora_renode.c, lr1110.c, lora_loopback.c (each stores recv_cb_user_data/async_cb_user_data beside the cb, cleared on EVERY disarm path - arm, cancel, self-disarm, fail rollback, root init - and passed as the callback's 6th argument from the lock-snapshotted pair), lora_l2_rx.c (isr_cb 6-param + ARG_UNUSED, 3 call sites pass NULL), tests/hal/src/main.c (consumer port, comment updated). RUNTIME VERIFIED on heft: lichen/tests/hal loopback scenario (prj_lora_loopback.conf) - test_loopback_recv_async_delivers_frames PASS on native_sim/native/64 (frame delivered through the 6-arg callback, cancel/re-arm semantics intact); full hal suite PROJECT EXECUTION SUCCESSFUL. Note for the suite's other consumers: ping_l2 build now fails ONLY on coap_status.c strnlen/sign-compare (filed as a separate bead, discovered-from mt5q) - after that lands, ping_l2 configures and the 5fva.1/.3 runtime debugging can proceed. Review: pass 1 found lr1110 stale user_data on self-disarm/fail paths + the missed tests/hal consumer (both fixed); pass 2 security PASS (no stale cb/user_data pairing - snapshots under the same lock; NULL passthrough never dereferenced); pass 3 edge PASS (double-arm -EBUSY leaves registration untouched; disarm-when-disarmed -EINVAL preserved; self-disarm clears both; no unported drivers).
